title: Effervescence-assisted dispersive micro-solid phase extraction
author: Lasarte Aragonés, Guillermo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare effervescent tablet
steps.instruction: Mix sodium carbonate (CO₂ source), sodium dihydrogen phosphate (proton donor), and OASIS‑HLB sorbent, then compress into a tablet.

steps.title: Load tablet into syringe
steps.instruction: Place the prepared tablet into a 10 mL glass syringe containing the aqueous sample.

steps.title: Generate CO₂ and extract
steps.instruction: Allow the tablet to react in situ, producing carbon dioxide that disperses the sorbent and extracts the target nitroaromatic compounds from the water.

steps.title: Recover sorbent by filtration
steps.instruction: After extraction, filter the syringe contents to collect the solid sorbent now loaded with analytes.

steps.title: Elute analytes with acetonitrile
steps.instruction: Pass acetonitrile through the recovered sorbent to elute the retained analytes for subsequent UPLC‑UV analysis.
